title: Existing mortgage rate vs. a new mortgage rate today

source.name: Share of outstanding mortgages under 4% vs. current 30-year fixed rate ('mortgage lock-in effect')
source.publisher: Federal Reserve / Redfin mortgage lock-in analyses

notes: Illustrative: most outstanding US mortgages carry rates under 4%, widely documented as the 'lock-in effect' discouraging moves, versus a new 30-year fixed rate near 7%.
